verdict: REFUTED (all three pre-registered zero-new-constant candidates), with a structural exclusion of the whole additive class. CONE PRUNE (formalize-first, stated before the scans): 11B and 19F carry the same light cluster (t) at k = 2 vs k = 4; every cluster-graph counting (per-bond m, per-bridged-triple C(m,2), per-nucleon-bond m*A_light, per-cluster 1, per-nucleon A_light) is non-decreasing 11B -> 19F while the measured miss DECREASES x2.40 (6.440 -> 2.679 MeV) — no non-negative combination of graph countings can close the trio (invariant: monotone counting cone vs strictly decreasing miss; conditional on the all-alpha decompositions and committed AME deficits; non-additive/saturating closures not excluded). (a) bridge copies: sub-reading a1 (per-bond, complete graph) IS committed Model G (open); a2 (+(m-1) copies) is x7.2 non-flat across the trio AND breaks 9Be (+1.33% of B). (b) gate = 3 clusters: granting 11B the gated pair leaves -36% of deficit unexplained AND the same rule breaks 9Be (+4.02% of B) — the alpha-only Milnor gate (I3) is confirmed at the discriminating multi-nucleon-spectator case. (c) sub-cluster promotion (max-B_add + Model-G cross interface): 11B = 7Li+alpha resid -73% of deficit (-8.3% of B), 14N = 13C+p -69% (-5.0% of B), 19F = 15N+alpha FLIPS SIGN to +134% (+3.6% of B) — brackets zero but nothing lands it; the closed six SURVIVE rule (c) (16O = 12C+alpha closes at -0.10% of B, a genuine coherence datum: promotion commutes with Model G when the sub-cluster's pairs are already gated on inside its AME value). CHARACTERIZATION: the trio is exactly {A_light >= 2 AND m >= 2}; the miss per nucleon-bond falls from 1.07 (11B) to 0.22 (19F); the 15N (3a+t) diagnostic (miss 8.05 MeV, -36%) makes the t-series NON-monotone in k (6.44 -> 8.05 -> 2.68), so the smooth -58/-33/-10 trend is partly an artifact of mixing d and t. The missing object is a SHARED (sub-additive, non-additive in the counting cone) channel of a multi-nucleon light cluster bonded to several alphas — scope-(a) for Model G's ingredients (nothing excluded as an ingredient); scope-(b) ONLY for the additive non-negative graph-counting class, with the cone invariant cited. Nothing tuned; b reused from the committed R5-a witness; no production wiring.
